      "quote": "I understand Khan academy supports 3rd grade and on. However, it doesn’t include the same interface and child-friendly fun."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R8",

      "claim": "A parent reports that the app changed to a Halloween theme, which they oppose.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This is suppose to be a kid friendly game. My daughter plays this all the time and now because it is October, you switch it to Halloween and because we are against Halloween with every ounce of our being, we can no longer let her play the game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R16",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app is suitable for a 5-year-old autistic child and holds their attention.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "He is five and Autistic I am only saying that to say that he was getting very frustrated with his his tablet and the apps. In my opinion it seemed like he was bored. So I downloaded this (actually for a refresher for my granddaughter before school started) and he uses it all day long."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R22",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app is too childish for a 7-year-old, as it only goes up to 2nd grade.",

      "quote": "It says 8+ and it only goes up to 2nd grade and this is a bit childish for a 7 year old because it was giving like easy things"

    {
      "ref": "R23",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that their 3-year-old loves the app and it helps with counting and letters.",

      "quote": "Such a wonderful resource, I rarely write reviews but I think this app and company deserves it. It’s the first thing my daughter asks to play after school every day. Really helps with counting and letters at her age."

    {
      "ref": "R27",
      "area": "age_gating",

    },
    {
      "ref": "R31",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app lacks sufficient parental control to remove content.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Parents should be able to remove or disable certain videos and other contents for kits to see."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R43",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app is free and does not require payment.",

      "quote": "ACTUALLY FREE YOU DONT NEED TO PAY"
    },

      "ref": "R44",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app is free and expresses gratitude for it being free.",
      "stance": "neutral",

    },
    {

      "quote": "My only down side is I wished it had like a path to follow instead of everyday it being anything I do like that but feel like I can’t really understand where my daughter is in the learning."
